---
title: "Case Studies"
description: "Every case study, playbook, paper and process design in the Robbins Analytics portfolio, in one list."
image: https://www.robbinsanalytics.com/assets/thumb-portfolio.png
image-alt: "Cascadia module card — title, one-line summary, and the data source."
# felix-index scopes the Felix page styling to this page (felix.scss), and
# hides Quarto's title block: the opener below carries the one H1, in the
# Felix inner-page form (eyebrow, H1 with the coloured stop, one sentence).
body-classes: felix-index
# custom, not full: the Felix opener and grid carry their own 76rem
# container, and Quarto's page grid would add a second set of gutters.
page-layout: custom
toc: false
# One Quarto listing over the inventory. Quarto hands a custom template
# `items`, `template-params` and `utils`, not the listing itself, so the
# group is named here. See _templates/fx-card.ejs and data/portfolio.yml.
listing:
  - id: fx-index
    contents: data/portfolio.yml
    template: _templates/fx-card.ejs
    sort: "order"
    page-size: 100
    template-params:
      group: index
      heading: h2
---
